lesson.state_and_constraint: A capital-intensive new line had reached construction completion before unit economics matured.
lesson.management_choice_or_no_action: Management added a second line before the first line had a mature capital return.
lesson.customer_or_operating_response: Customer certification and revenue improved while line profit remained unresolved.
lesson.cash_or_capital_result: Parent funding did not establish project cash recovery.
lesson.mechanism_lesson: Construction, customer absorption, and capital return are separate stages.
lesson.strongest_rival: Early losses can be normal ramp-up rather than permanent failure.
lesson.investor_treatment: Keep the option outside base owner cash until customer and unit-economic evidence converge.
lesson.transfer_question: Do customer absorption, line economics, and cash recovery improve together?
